5.instruction: Press the round brown 2x2 brick onto the center edge of the green half-circle plate.
watchFor: Place the brown brick near the straight edge so the second half-circle can join there.

5.instruction: Attach the second green half-circle plate on the other side of the brown brick to form a full circle.
watchFor: Straight edges must meet so the circle is complete and the brown brick sits in the middle.

6.instruction: Attach four dark green 2x2 slope bricks around the brown center piece on the green round plate, slopes facing outward.
watchFor: Slopes must face outward, with the studs side toward the brown center.
Space the four slopes evenly around the center.

7.instruction: Place the tan round 4x4 plate on top of the dark green slopes on the green base.
watchFor: Center the round plate over the slopes so it sits flat.

7.instruction: Attach the brown pronged piece to the tan plate, then press the brown round 2x2 brick on top.

parts.name: brown trunk base piece with prongs

watchFor: Line up the round brick's underside with the prongs so it seats fully.
Pronged piece goes on first, centered on the tan plate.

8.instruction: Place the tan round 2x2 plate with hole on top of the brown round 2x2 brick.
watchFor: Press the plate flat so the center hole lines up over the brick's middle.

8.instruction: Push the long gray axle through the stack and slip the brown axle connector onto the other end, then turn the model.
watchFor: Insert the axle from the plate side so the gray end sticks out beyond the brown brick.
Rotate the model as shown in the rotation icon.

9.instruction: Slide the brown branch piece onto the gray rods, pushing it down against the brown round brick at the end.
watchFor: Keep the branch arms pointing outward, as shown in the picture.

9.instruction: Slide the brown round brick onto the rods, then add the black round plate at the end.
watchFor: Push each piece fully down so there is no gap between them.

9.instruction: Push the finished brown trunk into the center of the green base, as the arrow shows.
watchFor: Press the trunk down until it sits flat on the tan ring of the base.

10.instruction: Attach the bright green leaf piece to the side of the tree trunk, and add two brown branch pieces to the trunk.
watchFor: Check the branches face the same way as in the picture.
Leaf piece goes on the right side of the trunk.

11.instruction: Add the white round plate subassembly with four black studs, one copy, to the build shown in the small picture.

parts.name: white round plate subassembly with pipe edges

watchFor: Keep the four black studs facing up as shown.

11.instruction: Press four yellow round 1x1 plates onto the four studs of the white round assembly.
watchFor: Place one yellow plate on each of the four center studs.

12.instruction: Place a hot pink curved slope on each of the four white clip plates around the yellow center.
watchFor: Point the curved slopes outward, matching the picture.
Add one slope to each of the four clip plates.

12.instruction: Press a light pink curved brick onto each of the four white clip plates around the center.
watchFor: Each pink piece covers both studs of its clip plate.
Keep the clips facing the same way as shown.

13.instruction: Attach tan plate to dark green curved slope, add black round plate underneath, flip, then attach the assembly to the pink flower's center.
watchFor: Rotate the assembly over before attaching it to the flower.
Keep the tan clips facing the direction shown.

13.instruction: Attach the pink flower assembly to the side of the brown tree trunk on the green base.
watchFor: Line the flower's connection up with the arrow point on the trunk.

14.instruction: Set the white hexagonal ring piece with the black studs on the work surface, ready for the next layer.

parts.name: white hexagonal ring plate with black studs

watchFor: Keep the black studs facing up.

14.instruction: Press four small magenta round plates onto the black studs of the white ring.
watchFor: Place one on each of the four black studs, none left empty.

15.instruction: Press a lavender curved slope onto each of the four white clip plates around the central build.
watchFor: Curved slope sits on the clip plate's stud with the curve facing outward.
Add one on every arm, four in total.

15.instruction: Attach each magenta curved brick onto the white clip plates, covering the plates on the four sides.
watchFor: Each curved brick covers both studs of its plate.
Keep the curve facing outward.

16.instruction: Join the tan handle plate to the dark green slope, add the black round plate, flip it, then attach it to the model's center.
watchFor: Clips on the tan plate must point toward the right, as in the flipped view.
Turn the assembly over before attaching it to the model.

17.instruction: Attach the finished purple flying creature to the tan arm sticking out of the brown tree trunk, then rotate the model to check.
watchFor: Push the creature's connection firmly onto the tan arm at the arrow.
Turn the model around to confirm the other side is built correctly.

18.instruction: Place the lime green leafy stem piece down as the base of the flower; make 2 in total.

parts.name: Lime green leaf stem plant piece

watchFor: Build this subassembly twice, as the 2x callout indicates.

18.instruction: Press a purple flower onto the stud at the end of the lime stem, then add a second purple flower on top.
watchFor: Stack the second flower on the first, with its petals offset so they do not line up.

18.instruction: Press a yellow round 1x1 plate onto the center of the top purple flower.
watchFor: Press the yellow plate onto the center stud so it sits in the middle of the flower.

19.instruction: Attach the pink and purple bird assembly onto the two brown studs on the tree trunk, pressing both connection points together.
watchFor: Line up both arrows so the bird's two connection points land on the matching studs of the trunk.

20.instruction: Push the blue pin into the top of the brown trunk, then slide the black angled connector onto the pin.
watchFor: Press the blue pin fully into the top of the trunk before adding the connector.
Keep the black connector's open side facing the same way as in the picture.

21.instruction: Push the dark gray axle connector down onto the top end of the long dark gray axle (size 4).
watchFor: Use the axle marked size 4; check the 1:1 length guide at the bottom.
Slide the connector onto the cross-shaped end of the axle.

21.instruction: Set the finished axle and connector assembly aside; it is the part you will use in the next steps.
watchFor: Keep the connector at the bottom, with the side pin pointing up and to the right.

22.instruction: Slide a yellow pulley wheel onto the gray axle of each small gray connector assembly. Make two.
watchFor: Build two identical assemblies (2x).
Push the yellow wheel fully down the axle.

22.instruction: Attach both gray axle assemblies to the top of the flower base, side by side, on the brown stem.
watchFor: Both axles point straight up with the yellow wheels at the top.

23.instruction: Push the gray pin down into the center hole of the dark brown three-way branch connector.
watchFor: Insert the pin into the center hole, not one of the arm ends.

23.instruction: Attach the lime green leaf piece on top of the pin in the brown branch connector.
watchFor: Press it fully onto the pin so it sits flat on the connector.

23.instruction: Insert two black and white axle pins into the open arm ends of the brown branch connector.
watchFor: Put the pins into the two free arm ends, not the center.

24.instruction: Attach two reddish-brown 1x1 cones onto the open ends of the brown branch piece.
watchFor: Point each cone's narrow end outward, away from the branch.

24.instruction: Attach two lime green leaf pieces to the cone ends of the branch, one on each cone.
watchFor: Clip each leaf piece onto the cone's top stud, matching the orientation shown.

25.instruction: Attach the two small lime green stem pieces to the lime leaf piece on the brown branch.
watchFor: The arrow shows the piece going into the lime leaf piece's end socket, so check it seats fully.

25.instruction: Slide the brown branch assembly onto the two gray pins at the top of the flower, in the arrow's direction.
watchFor: Line up both gray pegs with the branch's holes before pushing it on.

26.instruction: Push four dark gray claws onto the four dark gray clip pieces, then attach the two claw-and-clip pairs to the flower tower.
watchFor: Press each claw onto the clip end so the curve points downward.
Attach both pairs onto the matching gray connector pieces beside the yellow rings.

27.instruction: Attach the small reddish-brown cone piece to the left side of the gray claw piece on the flower tree.
watchFor: Push the cone into the left end of the gray piece, following the red arrow.

28.instruction: Start with the yellow inverted slope piece, studs facing up, as the base of this sub-build.
watchFor: Keep the slope upside-down so the angled sides point down and out.

28.instruction: Place the two yellow Technic bricks with pin holes on top of the center of the slope piece.
watchFor: Turn the pin holes to face the side of the build.

28.instruction: Add the orange 1x2 plate on the right top and the yellow clip plate on the left end.
watchFor: Clip faces outward at the left end.

28.instruction: Turn the build upright and push the black 4-length axle through the Technic holes. Add two yellow pin connectors.
watchFor: Center the axle so equal lengths stick out on each side.

29.instruction: Push the second yellow wing piece onto the black pin on the right side of the yellow bee body.
watchFor: Wing must be on the pin on the right side, opposite the existing wing.

30.instruction: Attach the white bracket upright onto the back end of the yellow 2x4 plate, studs facing up and sideways.
watchFor: Side studs of the white bracket face right.
Place the bracket at the end of the plate, not in the middle.

30.instruction: Attach two yellow side-stud 2x2 bricks to the plate, in front of the white bracket.
watchFor: Side studs on the bricks face right, matching the white bracket.

31.instruction: Attach the white brick with side studs to the right end of the build, next to the yellow brick.

parts.name: white brick with studs on four sides

watchFor: Side studs must face outward, matching the other white brick on the left.
Top studs should line up with the yellow brick beside it.

31.instruction: Place the red round plate on the left top, then the blue plate on the right top, overlapping behind it.
watchFor: Red round plate sits over the white brick at the front left.
Blue plate sits toward the back and right, over the yellow brick.

32.instruction: Place the light blue 1x2 plate on top of the orange plate at the back of the build.
watchFor: Light blue plate covers both studs of the orange plate, lined up with its long side.

32.instruction: Attach the pink 2x3 brick over the red round plate area, then press the red round plate on top.
watchFor: Pink brick sits on the front of the stack, leaving the light blue plate visible at the back.
Red round plate goes on the two studs of the pink brick, per the arrows.

33.instruction: Build a small stack: orange plate on a gray clip plate, white bracket, light blue plate, and a second gray clip plate; attach it to the model's top.
watchFor: Clips on both gray plates face the same side, toward the front-left.
Place the finished stack on the model where the arrow points, matching the orientation shown.

34.instruction: Attach the small and long light blue tiles to the model, covering the studs at the right side.
watchFor: Place the long tile along the right edge, not across the front.
Check that the tiles sit flat with no studs exposed.

34.instruction: Add two blue 1x1 bricks with side studs on top of the pink brick, side studs facing right.

parts.name: blue 1x1 brick with studs on side

watchFor: Side studs must face right, toward the light blue wall.
Set both bricks side by side behind the red round plate.

35.instruction: Attach the white brick with studs on all sides to the front of the model, next to the blue brick.

parts.name: white brick with studs on four sides

watchFor: Side studs must face outward, matching the picture.
Check that it sits beside the blue brick, not on top.

35.instruction: Turn the model around, then add the long light blue tile and the short light blue tile along the back edges.
watchFor: Rotate the model as the arrow shows before placing tiles.
Place the long tile upright along the side, short tile along the bottom.

36.instruction: Place the light blue 2x3 plate on the assembly shown in the faded top box.
watchFor: Match the plate's position and direction to the picture.

36.instruction: Attach the light blue 2x4 plate on top of the previous plate, offset toward the right.
watchFor: Line up the plate so it overhangs on the right side as shown.

36.instruction: Attach the dark blue plate with side studs to the right end of the stack.

parts.name: dark blue plate with side studs

watchFor: Side studs face right, outward.
Fit it under the top plate at the right end.

37.instruction: Place the light blue 2x3 plate on top of the stacked light blue plates, covering the front studs.
watchFor: Leave the dark blue studs at the back end uncovered.

37.instruction: Press the black round 2x2 plate onto the light blue studs, then place the blue curved slope on top.

parts.name: black round plate with rotating base

watchFor: Align the curved slope so its stepped edge faces the front, over the dark blue studs.

38.instruction: Place the blue 1x2 brick on the rear of the blue shell piece, then cap it with the curved slope.
watchFor: Curved slope's high edge must face the same way as the shell's curve.
Brick goes on the rear studs, not the front.

38.instruction: Attach the blue shell assembly to the side of the multicolored brick build, as the arrow shows.
watchFor: Line up the shell's curved side to face outward on the left of the build.

39.instruction: Build two orange-blue-pink curved sub-assemblies, then attach one to each side of the model, with the pink plate against the white bricks.
watchFor: Build two identical sub-assemblies, one for each side of the model.
Pink plate faces inward against the white bricks.

40.instruction: Attach an orange 2x2 plate to a yellow curved slope, add a second yellow slope, then fit the assembly onto the model's front.
watchFor: Orange plate studs sit under the first yellow slope's edge as shown.
Point the yellow piece's notched edge toward the arrow on the model.

41.instruction: Attach the finished blue and orange balloon assembly onto the yellow connector at the top of the stem, following the arrow.
watchFor: Line up the balloon's yellow base with the arrow so the blue side faces left and the orange side faces right.

42.instruction: Take one light blue 4x4 round plate and set it down with studs facing up as the base.
watchFor: Studs face up; the underside shows the open holes.

42.instruction: Place the blue 2x6 plate and green 2x2 round plate on the light blue round plate, with the green plate on the right.
watchFor: Blue plate extends to the left, overlapping the round plate edge.
Green round plate sits on the round plate's right side.

43.instruction: Flip the model over, then attach the blue quarter-round plate and the light blue 2x4 plate to the underside.
watchFor: Turn the model over before adding the plates
Round corner of the blue plate faces outward

43.instruction: Place the blue curved slope on the left and the light blue 1x4 tile on top of the plates.
watchFor: Curved slope should sweep up and away to the left
Tile sits flat over the blue plate edge

44.instruction: Add a light blue 2x3 plate, a small curved slope, and a medium blue 2x4 plate onto the top of the wing build.
watchFor: Place the small curved piece at the front end beside the 2x3 plate.
Keep the plates aligned with the long body axis.

44.instruction: Place the light blue curved slope and the medium blue 1x6 tile on top of the plates.
watchFor: The tile lies flat along the body, covering the studs.
Curve of the slope faces forward.

45.instruction: Attach three light blue round-cornered tiles onto the front rounded end of the blue fish body.
watchFor: Rounded corners should face outward along the curved front edge.

45.instruction: Place two medium blue 1x4 tiles on top of the body, side by side, running lengthwise.
watchFor: Turn the model so the tail points left, as shown, before placing the tiles.

46.instruction: Attach the blue curved slope piece to the front left of the model, next to the other blue curved piece.
watchFor: Match the curve direction to the neighboring blue curved piece.

46.instruction: Add the blue wedge plate and the small round blue tile to the front of the model, between the curved pieces.
watchFor: Check the wedge plate's angled side faces the correct direction.
Place the round tile on the open studs, rounded edge outward.

47.instruction: Press the gray ball-joint pin into the green round piece on top of the blue wing assembly.
watchFor: Turn the model over as shown so you can see the green piece on top.
Push the ball end upward so it sticks out.

47.instruction: Attach the blue wing assembly to the parrot's side by snapping its ball joint into the gray socket on the body.
watchFor: Line up the ball with the gray socket at the arrow.
Make sure the wing hangs on the correct side of the body.

48.instruction: Place the orange 2x8 plate flat as the base of this new sub-assembly.
watchFor: Check that the plate is 2 studs wide and 8 long.

48.instruction: Attach the dark blue curved slope at the far end of the orange plate, overhanging the end.
watchFor: Curve faces outward and the slope covers the end two studs.

48.instruction: Place the medium blue 2x8 plate on top, offset toward the front so the orange plate shows underneath.
watchFor: Offset the plate so the orange strip shows along the side.
Blue plate sits against the curved slope.

49.instruction: Attach the left and right orange wedge plates to the back end of the blue plate assembly.
watchFor: Keep the left and right wedges on their correct sides.
Point the wedge tips outward toward the back.

49.instruction: Place two yellow 1x2 plates with a handle on the orange wedges at the back end.
watchFor: Face the handle clips outward, toward the edges.
Press both plates onto the orange studs shown by the arrows.

50.instruction: Attach the light blue 1x2 plate, the blue 2x4 plate and the blue wedge plate onto the rear of the wing assembly.
watchFor: Put the small light blue plate at the rear end, next to the yellow pieces.
Face the wedge plate's notch toward the rear.

50.instruction: Place the curved blue slope on the front, then lay the long flat blue tile over the middle studs.
watchFor: Leave the front studs uncovered as shown.
Align the tile with the edges of the plates beneath.

51.instruction: Place the yellow round 2x2 plate on the studs at the wide end of the orange and blue tail piece.
watchFor: Check the tail assembly is turned the way the rotate icon shows before placing the plate.

51.instruction: Attach the blue and orange tail piece to the back of the parrot body, at the arrow, with the model turned as shown.
watchFor: Turn the model as the rotate icon shows before attaching.
Line the tail up with the yellow connector at the arrow.

52.instruction: Place the light blue round 4x4 plate upside down as the start of a new sub-assembly.
watchFor: Plate is shown upside down, with the underside facing up.

52.instruction: Place the blue 2x6 plate on the light blue round plate, then add the green round 2x2 plate on its end.
watchFor: Blue plate extends out to the left from the round plate.
Green round plate sits over the end of the blue plate.

53.instruction: Attach the blue quarter-round plate and the light blue 2x4 plate to the assembly, then turn the model over.
watchFor: Flip the model as shown by the rotate icon before attaching.
Curved edge of the blue plate faces outward.

53.instruction: Place the long blue curved slope on the underside and the light blue 1x4 tile on top of the plates.
watchFor: Curved slope tail points away from the round plate.
Tile sits centered along the seam of the plates.

54.instruction: Attach the light blue 2x3 plate and the medium blue 2x4 plate side by side on top of the blue model.
watchFor: The 2x4 plate goes on the left and the light blue 2x3 plate on the right, next to the round end.
Keep the plates lined up with the existing studs.

54.instruction: Press the light blue curved slope onto the two studs at the rounded end of the model. The small curved piece in the box is not shown going on.
watchFor: Follow the red arrows: the curve of the slope faces outward, toward the back right.
Press the slope onto exactly two studs.

55.instruction: Place two medium blue flat tiles side by side on top of the rear section of the model.
watchFor: Make sure the tiles sit flush on the studs at the back of the build, not over the front studs.

55.instruction: Attach three light blue rounded corner plates around the rear tip of the model.
watchFor: Orient the curved edges outward so they form a smooth rounded tail.

56.instruction: Attach the blue wedge plate and the small blue rounded plate to the front of the blue fin assembly.
watchFor: Point the wedge toward the front, matching the picture's angle.
Keep the rounded piece's curved edge facing outward.

56.instruction: Place the long light blue tile on top of the model, then add the blue curved slope on the left.
watchFor: Align the tile with the studs shown and leave the rear studs uncovered.
Orient the curved slope so its curve follows the body.

57.instruction: Flip the wing assembly over and add the gray ball-joint pin to the green round piece on the wing.
watchFor: Turn the model as shown by the rotate icon before attaching the pin.

57.instruction: Attach the finished wing to the left side of the bird's body, pressing it onto the ball joint.
watchFor: Line up the wing's socket with the ball joint on the body before pressing it on.

58.instruction: Press the orange 2x2 plate on top of the small yellow-orange 1x2 plate, lining up the two studs.
watchFor: The 2x2 plate covers the 1x2 plate's two studs, so they overlap on one side only.

58.instruction: Attach the blue 2x4 plate to the orange assembly, covering the left half of the orange plate.
watchFor: Orange 2x2 stays exposed at the right end of the blue plate.

58.instruction: Attach the blue slope to the left end, then press the orange 2x2 plate on top of the exposed right studs.
watchFor: Slope's high end faces the orange section, with its studs on the lower end.
Orange plate goes onto the exposed orange studs, not onto the slope.

59.instruction: Attach two blue 1x1 bricks with side studs to the back of the blue slope, next to the orange bricks.
watchFor: Side studs must face outward toward the left, away from the orange bricks.

59.instruction: Place a light blue 1x2 plate on top of the two side-stud bricks.
watchFor: Cover both side-stud bricks, with the plate's studs pointing up.

59.instruction: Add an orange 1x2 brick on the orange stack and a light blue 1x2 plate beside it.
watchFor: Put the orange brick on the orange stack, not on the blue part.

59.instruction: Stack an orange 1x2 brick on the orange stack, then put a yellow curved slope on top.
watchFor: The curved side of the yellow slope faces up and outward.

60.instruction: Press the black round 2x2 plate onto the reddish-brown 1x2 jumper plate with groove.
watchFor: Align the round plate over both studs of the brown plate.

60.instruction: Attach a black 1x2 plate and a white rounded plate on top of the round plate.
watchFor: White piece goes on the left side.

60.instruction: Add two white 1x2 bricks with side cutouts on top, one left and one right.
watchFor: Keep both cutouts facing the same way.

60.instruction: Place a black 1x2 plate on top of the left white brick.
watchFor: Put it on the left brick, not the right.

60.instruction: Add a white rounded plate and a black 1x2 plate on top, then attach the assembly to the model.
watchFor: Attach the finished piece to the arrow on the orange and blue model.

61.instruction: Attach the two blue curved arch bricks on top of the model's head, side by side behind the white front section.

parts.name: blue curved slope brick with stud

watchFor: Curve must face outward and downward, matching the picture.

61.instruction: Attach the two white bricks with side studs onto the front of the head, side studs facing out.

parts.name: white brick with studs on sides

watchFor: Side studs must face outward and to the front, as shown.

62.instruction: Attach a round black-and-white 1x1 tile to the white head piece, following the red arrow at the front.
watchFor: The callout shows 2 tiles but only one is shown being placed here; the second is added on the other side.
Check the tile's orientation so the white face points outward.

63.instruction: Place the white 2x2 plate as the base of the beak sub-assembly.
Attach the white 1x2 plate with center stud and the black 1x2 plate on top of the 2x2 plate.
watchFor: Black plate sits on the left side, white plate on the right.

63.instruction: Add the white rounded 1x2 plate on the left top of the assembly.
watchFor: Place it over the left two studs.

63.instruction: Attach the black curved slope on top, then push the small black round plate onto its underside.
watchFor: Slope points outward to the right.
Round plate goes underneath, from below.

64.instruction: Place the green round plate on the front of the head, then press the teal tile on top of the blue studs.
watchFor: The teal tile covers the two blue studs behind the green plate, not the green plate itself.

64.instruction: Attach the two light green curved slopes on the front of the teal tile, over the green round plate.
watchFor: Curved edges face forward and outward so the two slopes form a rounded beak top.

65.instruction: Rotate the finished parrot model to view the other side and attach the blue wing as shown by the arrow.
watchFor: The arrow points to the wing side, so check you are turning the model to the correct side.
